events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give permission to use your likeness.

venues.name: SNHU Arena

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: For general venue information, email info5@snhuarena.com or call (603) 644-5000. For group sales inquiries, email info5@snhuarena.com with the event you are interested in and your message will be directed to the appropriate sales team.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is open day-of-event only for all ticketed events. The box office will open a minimum of 90 minutes prior to the posted event start time. Please check the venue website or social media pages for specific dates and times. The box office is not open for walk-up advance sales on non-event days.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: All major credit cards Visa, MasterCard, Discover and American Express – are accepted at the box office. SNHU Arena is a cashless venue – cash is not accepted as payment at the venue box office or concession stands. No checks of any kind are accepted.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call tickets may be picked up day of show only. No advance pickup of tickets designated as will call delivery will be allowed. Customer must present the credit card used to purchase, a valid matching photo ID, and the Ticketmaster order number in order to claim the tickets.

venues.parkingDetail: There is limited on-site parking available for sale. Passes may be purchased as an add-on either as part of your ticket purchase or through the add-on listings on our Ticketmaster venue page. There are many public and private off-site parking lots within walking distance of the arena. Metered parking is also available on the surrounding streets, please obey posted parking restrictions and time limits. Limited ADA parking is available on-site, accessed off Elm Street via Cedar Street in the southwest corner of the arena property. On-street ADA parking is also available on Chestnut Street at the rear of the arena. ADA spaces are designated for vehicles displaying a current state-issued disability placard or license plate.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an accessible venue, accessible seating is available for purchase via Ticketmaster. To view current available inventory, please visit the Ticketmaster.com purchase page for your desired event.

generalInfo.generalRule: This venue has a clear bag policy: clear totes not exceeding 12"x6"x12" are the only bags permitted. Wristlets are permitted if they do not exceed 4"x6"x1". Backpacks and purses are not permitted. Limited exceptions for medical or diaper bags will be allowed. Camera policy varies by show, please check the venue website or social media for more information. No weapons of any kind. No outside food or beverage. No smoking is allowed and no smoking area is provided.
generalInfo.childRule: Children are welcome. For most events, children under 2 are admitted free if they are seated on a parent or guardians lap. Any children who will be occupying their own seat, regardless of age, must have a ticket. Discounted child tickets may be available for select events, please check the purchase page of your desired event for more information.

events.name: Limited Edition Rivals Replica Game Ball From Spalding®
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. How to Redeem Your Limited Edition Rivals Replica Game Ball from Spalding® Limited Edition Rivals Replica Game Ball from Spalding. Half Harlem Globetrotters, half Washington Generals, commemorating 75 years of the rivalry that started it all. To pick up your exclusive game ball, visit the Harlem Globetrotters Merchandise Stand located inside the venue on game day. Pick-up is only available during pre-game, half-time, or post-game. Ball MUST be picked up at the venue on the date of your ticketed event. No alternate pick-up dates, locations, nor shipping options are available. This purchase is NON TRANSFERABLE.

events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

events.info: Unlock your inner hero when Disney On Ice brings your favorite stories to the ice! Sail away with Moana and Maui on their epic voyage to return the heart of Te Fiti. Feel the chill with Anna, Elsa, and Olaf as they race to restore summer in Arendelle. Move to the rhythms of Encanto as Mirabel and her family celebrate the power of every unique gift. Be inspired by the Disney Princesses as you swim under the sea with Ariel, visit the enchanted castle with Belle, and chase your dreams alongside Rapunzel. Watch out for Stitch as his mischievous acts spark laughter around every corner. Hosted by Mickey and Friends, Disney On Ice presents Find Your Hero is a dazzling celebration of courage, kindness, and togetherness that will thrill every Disney fan! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older. Visit DisneyOnIce.com for more information.
events.pleaseNote: - All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. - No costumes for guests 14 & older. - Please monitor the venue website for venue policies, including health and safety protocols, which are subject to change. - All tickets are subject to availability. - Prices are subject to change. - Visit DisneyOnIce.com for more event info and Ticket Terms and Conditions.

venues.name: SNHU Arena

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: For general venue information, email info5@snhuarena.com or call (603) 644-5000. For group sales inquiries, email info5@snhuarena.com with the event you are interested in and your message will be directed to the appropriate sales team.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is open day-of-event only for all ticketed events. The box office will open a minimum of 90 minutes prior to the posted event start time. Please check the venue website or social media pages for specific dates and times. The box office is not open for walk-up advance sales on non-event days.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: All major credit cards Visa, MasterCard, Discover and American Express – are accepted at the box office. SNHU Arena is a cashless venue – cash is not accepted as payment at the venue box office or concession stands. No checks of any kind are accepted.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call tickets may be picked up day of show only. No advance pickup of tickets designated as will call delivery will be allowed. Customer must present the credit card used to purchase, a valid matching photo ID, and the Ticketmaster order number in order to claim the tickets.

venues.parkingDetail: There is limited on-site parking available for sale. Passes may be purchased as an add-on either as part of your ticket purchase or through the add-on listings on our Ticketmaster venue page. There are many public and private off-site parking lots within walking distance of the arena. Metered parking is also available on the surrounding streets, please obey posted parking restrictions and time limits. Limited ADA parking is available on-site, accessed off Elm Street via Cedar Street in the southwest corner of the arena property. On-street ADA parking is also available on Chestnut Street at the rear of the arena. ADA spaces are designated for vehicles displaying a current state-issued disability placard or license plate.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an accessible venue, accessible seating is available for purchase via Ticketmaster. To view current available inventory, please visit the Ticketmaster.com purchase page for your desired event.

generalInfo.generalRule: This venue has a clear bag policy: clear totes not exceeding 12"x6"x12" are the only bags permitted. Wristlets are permitted if they do not exceed 4"x6"x1". Backpacks and purses are not permitted. Limited exceptions for medical or diaper bags will be allowed. Camera policy varies by show, please check the venue website or social media for more information. No weapons of any kind. No outside food or beverage. No smoking is allowed and no smoking area is provided.
generalInfo.childRule: Children are welcome. For most events, children under 2 are admitted free if they are seated on a parent or guardians lap. Any children who will be occupying their own seat, regardless of age, must have a ticket. Discounted child tickets may be available for select events, please check the purchase page of your desired event for more information.
